blind_spots.name: minority_low_class
blind_spots.evidence: Only 179 of 10000 zone rows are Low risk; Stage 01's Low recall is its weakest (0.71). Calm conditions are the least rehearsed.

blind_spots.name: beyond_record_rainfall
blind_spots.evidence: No value exceeds the recorded ceiling of 104, and 295 rows (2.95%) sit exactly on it: the upper tail was capped during cleaning, so true extremes are censored. IMD classes >= 204.5 mm/day as 'extremely heavy'; if rainfall_mm is a daily total, the most extreme real events lie wholly outside the record.

blind_spots.name: urban_waterlogging
blind_spots.evidence: Top-5% rainfall while the river sits > 2 m below its danger mark: streets flood from rain alone, a pattern a river-gauge-centred model rarely sees.

blind_spots.name: silent_rise
blind_spots.evidence: River > 2 m above danger while calls are in the bottom decile -- a night-time rise while residents sleep.

blind_spots.name: receding_but_severe
blind_spots.evidence: Severe zones with a clearly falling river: the forecast says 'calming', the present says 'emergency'.

blind_spots.name: dry_season_severe
blind_spots.evidence: Severe events outside June-September. Stage 01 uses an is_monsoon feature, so an out-of-season flood tests whether that prior over-rides the sensors.

blind_spots.name: night_onset
blind_spots.evidence: Events recorded between 00:00 and 05:59 (the mission's 2 AM window).

blind_spots.name: multi_zone_simultaneity
blind_spots.evidence: Of 10,000 distinct timestamps, 0 have >= 3 Severe zones at once (max concurrent: 1). Every row is one zone in isolation; competing zones are not represented.

blind_spots.name: missing_or_faulty_telemetry
blind_spots.evidence: The labelled sensor data has 0 missing values: gauges never go offline, freeze, or report impossible readings in the record.

blind_spots.name: infrastructure_failure
blind_spots.evidence: No field describes power, telecom or bridge integrity as a failing system. A grid outage that blinds cameras and gauges is unrepresentable.

blind_spots.name: cross_modal_conflict
blind_spots.evidence: No joint dataset links sensors, imagery and text for the same event, so modality disagreement (a calm gauge beside people trapped) has never been exercised.

blind_spots.name: noisy_or_code_mixed_text
blind_spots.evidence: 100.0% of sampled dispatcher messages fit one fixed template. Typos, all-caps panic, Hinglish and truncated SMS are absent.

blind_spots.name: negated_hazard_language
blind_spots.evidence: Messages that mention a hazard only to deny it ('no flooding here'). Stage 03 has no negation handling (documented limitation).

blind_spots.name: beyond_record_water_change
blind_spots.evidence: No value exceeds the recorded ceiling of 1.575, and 30 rows (0.30%) sit exactly on it: the upper tail was capped during cleaning, so true extremes are censored. Real CWC gauges (Stage 02 raw) show 6 h rises of 1.55 m at the 99th percentile; dam-release step changes sit beyond the labelled record.

blind_spots.name: mass_casualty_headcount
blind_spots.evidence: Largest dispatcher headcount is 120; hospital-scale evacuations (hundreds of people) never appear.

blind_spots.name: multi_hazard_message
blind_spots.evidence: Every one of 60,000 dispatcher messages carries exactly one hazard label; compound flood + road + medical reports are absent.

blind_spots.name: forward_looking_labels
blind_spots.evidence: zone_risk labels describe the present. Nothing marks a zone that is Moderate now but will be Severe in 6 h, so pre-positioning decisions are never supervised.
